subject: The Strength Sweet Spot: How 90 Minutes of Lifting Rewires Your Biology for a Longer Life
script: From Agewell Brief: The Strength Sweet Spot: How 90 Minutes of Lifting Rewires Your Biology for a Longer Life. New observational data from nearly 150,000 health professionals reveals that just 90–120 minutes of weekly strength training is linked to a 13% lower risk of early death—and when paired with aerobic exercise, the risk drops by 45%. Here’s the muscle biology behind the numbers. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
